day_shape: 67 items: Trump declares Strait of Hormuz 'US territory' and rules out Iran talks while Ghalibaf says strait stays shut until sanctions lift, heavy Khamenei-office fortieth-day commemoration cycle for the 'Martyred Leader', Israeli strikes reported on Abu al-Zuhour airfield in Syria, IDF recovers remains of Yehuda Katz from Lebanon after 44 years; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz standoff hardens
threads.summary: Trump declared on Truth Social that the Strait of Hormuz is now US territory and said there are no talks scheduled with Iran, while Iranian negotiator Ghalibaf said the strait would remain closed until sanctions are lifted and frozen assets released. First Vice President Aref said Iran would 'stand by its rights' in managing the strait, and Reuters reported two Chinese state tanker firms have stopped transiting Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab.

threads.label: Fortieth-day commemoration of 'Martyred Leader'
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB carried extensive coverage of the fortieth-day funeral and commemoration ceremony at Tehran's Imam Khomeini Prayer Ground, with Speaker Qalibaf, Judiciary head Mohseni Eje'i, SNSC secretary Rezaei and Hassan Khomeini in attendance. Defa Press and IRIB posted crowd chants of 'Death to America, death to Israel' and IRGC commander Hassanzadeh said the 'blood of the Martyred Leader' had brought defeats to the 'front of disbelief'.

threads.label: Syria airfield strike and IAEA nuclear material
threads.summary: Arab media including Al Jazeera and Al Hadath reported four overnight strikes on the runway of Abu al-Zuhour military airport near Idlib, attributed to Israel; Defa Press cited a Syrian military source saying the airfield was hit eight times with infrastructure damage and no casualties. Separately, Al-Hadath reported the IAEA had discovered and collected nuclear material in Syria, with FM al-Shaibani saying it would remain under Damascus's control.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said Islamic Jihad company commander Tareq Anwar Khamis Ra'i, who invaded Kibbutz Be'eri on 7 October 2023 and took part in a hostage abduction, was killed in a Khan Younis strike on Sunday. The military also announced that findings believed to be the remains of Sgt First Class Yehuda Katz, missing since the 1982 battle of Sultan Yacoub, were recovered in a joint Mossad-IDF covert operation in Lebanon.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and diaspora
threads.summary: Iran International reported security forces detained three relatives of Kian Pirfalak, a nine-year-old killed in the 2022 protests, and published a leaked audio of Basij officials discussing fear of new protests and online exposure. Canada deported a former Interior Ministry spokesman linked to the November 2019 crackdown, while other Iranian men conscripted into the IRGC said Canadian letters warned their service could count as terrorist membership.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic and war narrative
threads.summary: FM Araghchi told an educators' conference that Iran had pushed to continue the war with the United States to force a ceasefire on its own terms, while a French diplomatic source told Iran International that Tehran's espionage allegations against two briefly detained French diplomats were 'completely false'. Defa Press quoted IRGC adviser General Nagdi on alleged Turkish intelligence contacts and Trump 'baiting' Rubio, and carried an Omani commentator's piece calling Trump 'defeated militarily'.

threads.label: Regional flashpoints: Erbil, UNIFIL, Gulf rift
threads.summary: Defa Press framed the 'Hadid 110' strike on the residence of the Kurdistan Region's top executive in Pirmam near Erbil as marking a new phase in regional security, while Lebanese President Aoun told lawmakers his 'first option' was extending UNIFIL's mandate before its year-end expiry. Saudi Arabia placed financial transfers to the UAE under enhanced high-risk regulatory oversight, and Kushner warned Hamas the US could back Israel to 'finish the job' if disarmament commitments are not honoured.

events.summary: Allegations by Iran’s Intelligence Ministry that two French diplomats briefly detained in Tehran last month were involved in espionage are “completely false,” a French diplomatic source told Iran International.
